title: PR #6490 moved structure-board rendering into a new generic render_object_structure admin endpoint and dropped the user_can_change_page check the old details() path applied, so any staff user can read the plugin structure of pages they may not view.

findings.explanation: The changes only add permission checks and a cycle‑detection guard. No SQL statements are introduced or modified, and existing queries (if any) remain unchanged and continue to use the framework's ORM with parameter binding.

The patch adds explicit source‑side permission checks before allowing copy or move operations, preventing unauthorized users from reading or exfiltrating plugin data. No new endpoints are introduced without authorization, and existing checks are reinforced, so no authorization flaw is introduced.

evidence.content:
if not source_placeholder.has_add_plugins_permission(request.user, old_plugins):
    message = _('You do not have permission to copy these plugins.')
    raise PermissionDenied(message)

if not source_placeholder.check_source(request.user):
    message = _('You do not have permission to copy these plugins.')
    raise PermissionDenied(message)

# Cycle‑detection guard added later in the file to prevent unauthorized re‑parenting that could cause DoS.
